title: the launch line of the dispatcher prompt starts with the launcher itself, no bun word, and it is the line the dispatch guard allows
source: intended: docs/architecture.md section 6 (hooks are subcommands) and section 9 (the prompt template says {{LAUNCHER}} launch)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-8, launcher line). The fixture prompt template (jitso/dispatcher/prompt.md) writes the launch command as `{{LAUNCHER}} launch ...` with no `bun` in front, since the Go launcher is an executable, not a Bun script. The rendered system prompt must therefore contain a line that starts with the launcher (a regex on the line start, so a `bun` word in front does not match) `{{JITSO}} launch --build <id> --brief <dispatcher briefs folder>/<slug>.md --mode direct`, where {{JITSO}} is the launcher as the dispatch guard recognizes it, and the guard allows exactly that line. The TS binary renders {{LAUNCHER}} as the path of index.ts and its guard allows only `bun <index.ts> launch`, so the prompt line starts with `<index.ts> launch` while {{JITSO}} is `bun <index.ts>`: the regex expectation FAILS on TS. Only the launcher word is pinned, not how an implementation spells its own path; the launcher in the prompt and the one the guard compares are the same real path, so on a platform where the sandbox folder is a symlink (darwin /tmp) pass a real path in --bin. The launcher line in its guard step carries `--build` (build vocabulary, defect N-10; docs/decisions.md D6), a flag the oracle guard does not allow either. Since N-29 the guarded line also carries --worktree path:<primary> (the prompt line already does, defect N-23), and the hook step sets JITSO_PROJECT.
